prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [sign_in, reorder] Move sign-in after pet adoption: Reorder the onboarding sequence so users select and customize their pet before signing in. The sign-in prompt is presented right before pet generation.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"], "sign_in": {"headline": "Save Your New Desktop Pet", "hint": "Sign in to bond this pet to your account permanently."}}
1: [home, redesign] Interactive tip carousel on waiting screen: Redesign the waiting screen layout to a stage layout with a full interactive tip carousel explaining desktop controls, shortcuts, and hiding mechanisms while waiting.
   config: {"waiting": {"layout": "stage", "headline": "Preparing Your Pet's New Desktop Home", "body": "Your companion is getting ready. Browse quick tips below to learn how to interact with your pet.", "components": [{"type": "tip_carousel", "style": "playful", "action": "open_tip", "text": "Controls Guide: Double click to talk, right click to hide or bring to front."}]}}
2: [finish, new_screen] Add dedicated desktop controls tutorial screen: Add a new interactive tutorial screen right after home introduction demonstrating how to summon, position, hide, and interact with the desktop pet.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_controls_tutorial"], "home_intro": {"button_label": "Learn Pet Controls"}}
3: [adoption, new_flow] Preset selection preview flow for custom pet photo upload: Replace photo upload area with instant preset choices and a real-time preview card before photo upload to reduce custom pet generation errors.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"layout": "grid", "headline": "Pick a Style or Upload a Photo", "replace": {"photo_upload": [{"type": "choice_cards", "role": "photo_upload", "style": "rounded", "action": "choose"}, {"type": "preview", "role": "photo_upload", "style": "highlight"}]}}}
4: [sign_in, copy] Account sign-in warning copy for pet sync: Add clear helper text explaining that signing in with the original email restores existing pets and prevents account resets.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Sign In to Sync Your Desktop Pets", "body": "Use your primary account email to automatically restore previous pets and keep your collection safe.", "hint": "Using a different email creates a separate empty profile."}}
5: [home, wait_info] Progress indicator and desktop alert toggle on waiting screen: Enable visual progress percentage, estimated timer, and system desktop notification switch on the waiting screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "We will notify you on your desktop as soon as your pet is ready!"}}
6: [finish, hint] Desktop display shortcut hint on final intro screen: Display a prominent hint on the intro screen detailing shortcut keys (e.g., Ctrl+Shift+P) to bring the pet to the top window.
   config: {"home_intro": {"hint": "Pet missing from desktop? Press Ctrl+Shift+P or check your system tray icon to reveal your pet."}}
7: [choose_path, layout] Split layout for choose path screen: Reorganize choose_path screen into a split layout with interactive visual choice cards to speed up decision making.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Select Your Adoption Journey", "replace": {"path_options": [{"type": "choice_cards", "role": "path_options", "style": "playful", "action": "choose"}]}}}
8: [adoption, incentive] Adoption certificate starter accessory badge: Add a prominent reward badge highlighting a bonus free desktop pet item upon completing the certificate step.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"headline": "Complete Certificate & Unlock Starter Toy", "components": [{"type": "badge", "label": "Bonus Desktop Toy Unlocked", "style": "highlight"}]}}
9: [home, notification] Background notification permission switch on waiting screen: Add a desktop notification prompt on the waiting screen allowing users to minimize the app without missing completion.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "body": "Your pet is being crafted in the background. Enable notifications so you can freely use other desktop apps."}}

verdicts.reason: Reordering sign-in to occur after pet adoption is explicitly allowed under Rule 4.
Redesigning the waiting screen layout while keeping pet preparation messaging retains the screen's core job.
Adding a new controls tutorial screen after home_intro is permitted under Rule 4.
Replacing the photo upload component with preset choices loses the photo upload functionality/job.
Adding sign-in helper copy to clarify account sync is allowed and respects all base rules.
Adding progress indicators and desktop alert switches to a real waiting screen is allowed under Rules 4 and 5.
Adding shortcut display hints to home_intro is allowed inside onboarding.
Redesigning choose_path into a split layout preserves the choice between adopting and creating a pet.
Onboarding copy mentions a bonus free gift/toy, violating Rule 3.
Adding a desktop notification permission switch on the waiting screen is permitted under Rule 4.
